result_contract.context_policy: For each applicable item, put target scope, location, and rationale in supported result context fields when available, or state all three explicitly in reason; evidence must identify final output artifacts.
result_contract.group_evidence_when: evidence enumerates the exhaustive final target set

catalog_item_fields.applicability_policy: Every catalog row is required in acceptance.items. An always row must remain applicable:true; a conditional row may use applicable:false only with status na/not_applicable and a reason for the explicit out-of-scope condition.

major_checks.summary: 需求、範圍、文字、證據與交付條件。
敏感類別遮蔽、控制項可讀性與金額預設保留。
標註、控制項、狀態、步驟與計算操作語意。
DOCX 結構、文字/圖片讀回與相對可用內容區的版面結構。
